title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery…
description: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg versions before 3.2.12 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows users with Contributor-level privileges to cause the server to make HTTP requests to arbitrary hosts by submitting crafted Mailchimp API keys. The vulnerability involves the otter/v1/form/editor REST route, where the apiKey's data-center segment can embed a host, enabling attackers to follow redirects to internal services and read partial responses.
